meta.title: Enable Swift benchmarking
meta.body_summary: Add benchmarking support to Swift transpiler: enable benchmark mode, record memory via /proc/self/status, update Rosetta checklist with table format, and regenerate code for 100-doors-2.

core_change_summary.description: Added benchmark mode to Swift transpiler: if MOCHI_BENCHMARK env var is set, the transpiler emits Swift code that records memory usage via /proc/self/status and execution time in nanoseconds. Updated the Rosetta checklist with a table format and benchmark data, and regenerated Swift code and outputs for program 100-doors-2.
